name: Surplus is not a cycle
description: One variable, two values. The unmatched value supports its edge through a free-value path, though each alternating SCC is a singleton.

name: Tight Hall bottleneck
description: Two variables reserve values 0 and 1; neither edge from those values to x2 is supported.

name: Alternating cycle
description: Flipping the four-edge alternating cycle exchanges both assignments.

name: Long free path
description: The free value can start a longer chain of matching changes.

name: Matched does not mean supported
description: Maximum partial matching covers two variables, not all three. No original edge has a complete support.

name: Disconnected support mechanisms
description: One component has a cycle, another uses surplus paths, and isolated values stay visible.

name: Noninterval domains
description: Values 0, 2 and 5 make the alternating graph independent of interval bounds.

name: Empty domain
description: An empty domain is an explicit Hall obstruction, not a missing variable.

name: Empty scope
description: The empty tuple is a full matching. All supplied values are free isolated vertices.

name: Empty universe
description: No variables and no values: one empty matching, no arcs or components.

name: Unique matching
description: Every matched edge is supported but need not lie on an alternating cycle.

name: Full bounded graph
description: Six variables and eight values; all 48 original edges have explicit full support.
